scientific_integrity: Analytical Lyapunov proof, all-state formula, reproducibility program; tested finite cases do not constitute the proof. No external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform one-dimensional nearest-neighbor path, one continuously absorbing endpoint, positive finite rates; no dephasing, multiple sinks, detuning or general finite-time law. Priority against inaccessible early quantum-transport full text remains provisional.
title: Exact state-dependent capture times and optimal sink strength on finite quantum paths
